summary: fractal-web terminal input now admits keys against the live screen of the terminal the view shows: the input session reads that screen through the view's subject address (terminal/<agent path>) and still posts and fences with the gateway's own terminal id (terminal/<agent id>), so typing no longer fails on every live gateway with "The terminal restarted or stopped updating".

replay.detail: Client-only change; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: Client-only change against the existing gateway terminal.input action; the posted terminal id and fences are unchanged.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; the app is not deployed by this change.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
